visual.description: Pure black used as the primary page and hero background throughout the site.
Near-black surface used for content sections and card-like areas.
Very dark near-black background of the navigation bar in its scrolled/opaque state.
Off-white used for all major headings and large display text.
Pure white used for body copy and paragraph text on dark backgrounds.
Light grey used for secondary or supporting body text.
Off-white used for navigation link labels in both states.
Off-white used for navigation items in the top-of-page transparent state.
Off-white navigation text color retained after scroll when nav becomes opaque.
Off-white navigation link color in scrolled state.
Transparent/black background for navigation at top of page overlaying hero content.
Black fill used as background for the primary CTA button (EXPLORE).
Off-white border used on CTA buttons and UI outlines.
Warm amber-orange dominant color of the Mars planet hero image, part of the brand's visual signature.
Muted steel-blue dominant tone of the rocket launch and sky imagery sections.
Dark charcoal used as semi-transparent overlays on video and image sections.
Dark grey used for the secondary CTA button variant (LEARN MORE) against image backgrounds.
